findings.title: Root Account Must Have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Enabled
findings.rationale: CRITICAL: The root account is active without Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
findings.remediation_cli: aws iam enable-mfa-device --user-name root --serial-number <MFA_SERIAL>

findings.title: IAM Policies Must Not Grant Wildcard Full Administrative Privileges
findings.rationale: HIGH: Role has inline/attached policies granting full '*:*' wildcard administrative control.
findings.remediation_cli: aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name DevOps-Pipeline-Executor --policy-name OverlyPermissiveAdminAccess

findings.title: IAM Policies Must Not Grant Wildcard Full Administrative Privileges
findings.rationale: All attached policies adhere to granular resource and action scoping.
findings.remediation_cli: aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name svc-reporting-etl --policy-name OverlyPermissiveAdminAccess

findings.title: User Access Keys Must Be Rotated Every 90 Days or Less
findings.rationale: MEDIUM: Access key has been active for 182 days without rotation (exceeds 90-day threshold).
findings.remediation_cli: aws iam update-access-key --user-name svc-reporting-etl --access-key-id <KEY_ID> --status Inactive

findings.title: IAM Policies Must Not Grant Wildcard Full Administrative Privileges
findings.rationale: All attached policies adhere to granular resource and action scoping.
findings.remediation_cli: aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name secops-analyst-lead --policy-name OverlyPermissiveAdminAccess

findings.title: User Access Keys Must Be Rotated Every 90 Days or Less
findings.rationale: Access key age is 24 days (within compliant 90-day lifecycle).
findings.remediation_cli: aws iam update-access-key --user-name secops-analyst-lead --access-key-id <KEY_ID> --status Inactive

findings.title: Cloud Storage Buckets & Containers Must Block Public Anonymous Read Access
findings.rationale: CRITICAL: Storage account / bucket allows anonymous internet users to read or download objects.
findings.remediation_cli: az storage account update --name stgcorprawcustomers --allow-blob-public-access false

findings.title: Storage at Rest Must Enforce Server-Side Encryption (SSE)
findings.rationale: Server-side encryption is active and protecting object data at rest.
findings.remediation_cli: az storage account update --name stgcorprawcustomers --encryption-services blob

findings.title: Storage Must Enforce Secure Transfer (HTTPS/TLS Only)
findings.rationale: MEDIUM: Unencrypted plain HTTP requests are accepted by this storage account.
findings.remediation_cli: az storage account update --name stgcorprawcustomers --https-only true

findings.title: Cloud Storage Buckets & Containers Must Block Public Anonymous Read Access
findings.rationale: Public access block is actively enforced. Anonymous access is strictly prohibited.
findings.remediation_cli: aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket corp-finance-archive-2026 --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true

findings.title: Storage at Rest Must Enforce Server-Side Encryption (SSE)
findings.rationale: HIGH: Storage bucket does not have default server-side encryption enabled.
findings.remediation_cli: aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket corp-finance-archive-2026 --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules": [{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault": {"SSEAlgorithm": "AES256"}}]}'

findings.title: Storage Must Enforce Secure Transfer (HTTPS/TLS Only)
findings.rationale: MEDIUM: Unencrypted plain HTTP requests are accepted by this storage account.
findings.remediation_cli: aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket corp-finance-archive-2026 --policy <ENFORCE_TLS_POLICY_JSON>

findings.title: Cloud Storage Buckets & Containers Must Block Public Anonymous Read Access
findings.rationale: Public access block is actively enforced. Anonymous access is strictly prohibited.
findings.remediation_cli: aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket corp-immutable-audit-vault --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true

findings.title: Storage at Rest Must Enforce Server-Side Encryption (SSE)
findings.rationale: Server-side encryption is active and protecting object data at rest.
findings.remediation_cli: aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket corp-immutable-audit-vault --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules": [{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault": {"SSEAlgorithm": "AES256"}}]}'

findings.title: Storage Must Enforce Secure Transfer (HTTPS/TLS Only)
findings.rationale: Secure transfer (HTTPS/TLS) is strictly enforced for all API and data endpoints.
findings.remediation_cli: aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket corp-immutable-audit-vault --policy <ENFORCE_TLS_POLICY_JSON>

findings.title: Network Security Groups Must Restrict Inbound RDP (Port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.rationale: CRITICAL: Inbound security rule 'Allow-Any-RDP' allows unauthenticated public access to RDP (3389).
findings.remediation_cli: az network nsg rule delete --resource-group <RG> --nsg-name nsg-dmz-perimeter --name Allow-Any-RDP

findings.title: Network Security Groups Must Restrict Inbound SSH (Port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.rationale: HIGH: Inbound security rule 'Allow-Any-SSH' allows unauthenticated public access to SSH (22).
findings.remediation_cli: az network nsg rule delete --resource-group <RG> --nsg-name nsg-dmz-perimeter --name Allow-Any-SSH

findings.title: Database Ports (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL) Must Not Be Publicly Accessible
findings.rationale: All database ports are isolated within private virtual network boundaries.
findings.remediation_cli: az network nsg rule delete --resource-group <RG> --nsg-name nsg-dmz-perimeter --name Allow-Database-Public

findings.title: Network Security Groups Must Restrict Inbound RDP (Port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.rationale: Inbound RDP port 3389 is restricted to private CIDRs or blocked.
findings.remediation_cli: az network nsg rule delete --resource-group <RG> --nsg-name nsg-prod-databases --name Allow-Any-RDP

findings.title: Network Security Groups Must Restrict Inbound SSH (Port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.rationale: Inbound SSH port 22 is restricted to authorized management subnets.
findings.remediation_cli: az network nsg rule delete --resource-group <RG> --nsg-name nsg-prod-databases --name Allow-Any-SSH

findings.title: Virtual Machine OS and Data Disks Must Be Encrypted at Rest
findings.rationale: HIGH: Virtual Machine OS disk is unencrypted at rest.
findings.remediation_cli: az vm encryption enable --resource-group <RG> --name vm-legacy-reporting --disk-encryption-keyvault <VAULT_NAME>

findings.title: Virtual Machines Should Not Have Direct Public IP Addresses Attached
findings.rationale: MEDIUM: VM has direct public IP '52.167.44.119' exposed to the public internet.
findings.remediation_cli: az network nic ip-config update --resource-group <RG> --nic-name <NIC> --name <IP_CONFIG> --remove publicIpAddress

findings.title: Central Cloud Audit Logging Must Be Enabled with Minimum 90-Day Retention
findings.rationale: CRITICAL: Central cloud activity logging is disabled or has insufficient retention (< 90 days).
findings.remediation_cli: az monitor log-profiles create --name default --categories Write Delete Action --locations global eastus --days 365 --enabled true
